locator.text: Display 72.1, p. 72, in the proof of Proposition 6.6

evidence: paper: \zeta^2 \le \zeta, \qquad \zeta^{3/2} P_v \le \sqrt{\zeta}\, P_v, \qquad \zeta P_v^2 \le \begin{cases} \zeta, & m+m'=0,\\ \sqrt{\zeta}\, P_v, & m+m'\neq 0.\end{cases}

provenance.note: machine audit: worker, gate, reviewer; not confirmed by a human

verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. All four inequalities of the display are present in Lean with the same constants, exponents and directions, but each as a step inside a different class-closure lemma in two files rather than as one display. Rewriting: Lean never writes a fractional power; it writes `s.zeta x * (Real.sqrt (s.zeta x) * P n x)` and `(Real.sqrt (s.zeta x) * P n x) * (Real.sqrt (s.zeta x) * P n x)` where the paper writes ζ^{3/2}P_v and ζP_v^2, equal for ζ ≥ 0 by `Real.sq_sqrt` (which `WaveClass.bilinear_mean` uses explicitly at line 426). Hypotheses: the paper's running assumption is 0 ≤ ζ ≤ 1 and 0 < P_v ≤ 1; Lean carries `s.zeta_nonneg`, an explicit `hζ : ∀ x ∈ s.domain, s.zeta x ≤ 1` where needed, and `hP0 : 0 ≤ P n x` (not strict) with `hP1 : P n x ≤ 1`, so Lean assumes slightly less on P. The paper's case split on m+m' does not appear in the Lean inequality: both branches of the third inequality are proved unconditionally (ζP_v^2 ≤ ζ in `WaveClass.bilinear_mean`, ζP_v^2 ≤ √ζ P_v in `wave_cmul_wave`), and the harmonic condition m+m'=0 selects which conclusion is used rather than which inequality holds; note `WaveClass.bilinear_mean` needs only P ≤ 1 and not ζ ≤ 1.
